text: They made an appointment but didn't call. When we scheduled another appointment and I arrived on time, they asked me to reschedule again.
The doctor is good; everything was explained in detail and clearly. You can use your universal healthcare benefits here.

We were flying into Bangkok for a short visit when our son started having a major toothache during the descend. He was in so much pain he wanted to pull his tooth out... We needed get him checked out before our next flight, found this clinic and walked in. He was fully booked on the day we dropped in but the doctor understood our situation and took our son in to make sure he didn't have a cavity or a crack on his tooth so we can fly again the next day. We were so releaved and thankful that he took our son in for a check up and didn't even charge us for it. Thank you so much 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

This was my first time getting dental scaling here, using my NHSO hotline benefit. The receptionist was very kind and welcoming. The dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. The clinic was clean.

Highly recommend!

Personally, I'm really afraid of dentists because I have a lot of cavities.
I decided to try using my government health insurance.
I made an appointment. The dentist was kind, gave good advice, was skilled, and gentle.
I got a scaling done once a year and two fillings.
I paid for everything else myself. The prices weren't too high, and all the dentists are very skilled. I can confirm that!

I have been there more than 10 years, they have good service and explaining well.
Every dentists I had appointment with were excellent in the job and very gentle.
Highly recommend

Needed a cleaning done in Bangkok, and while this place had no reviews they were the only one open on Sunday. While the receptionist doesn't speak much english, the dentist does, and she's very nice.

Cleanings cost from 700 to 1,000 baht - mine cost closer to 1,000 and was very thorough (descaling, ultrasonic, etc for over half an hour). My friends' cleanings were shorter, and cost about 800 baht.

Clinic was clean and I literally walked in for an appointment on the spot. Worth a go if you need dental work done!
